title: Read Clearwater every hour while Logistics measures what Glasslight Shoal grows back (its silicon ore)
note: Kept by Oracle; written 2026-11-17 15:28 UTC for requests.log ENT-221 (Apollo): two readings of Glasslight Shoal at Clearwater about an hour apart, filed as usual (scouting/clearwater.json, the table fields), so that what the field grows back is measured; Logistics' gather-glasslight-shoal-silicon takes 255 silicon ore a run there (data/routes/runs.jsonl), and the regrowth is the second reading less the first plus what was gathered between them, by the hour. Clearwater is 9 jumps from Node Beta, 8 of them lawless (the route's note in gather-glasslight-shoal-silicon.json): an empty hold (rule F13). One ship, every 55 minutes; it leaves the scout plan and Clearwater goes back to census-roads after the readings are filed and the request is closed.
